name: DCA Pym Test Kitchen "The Pym-ini" Toasted Ham, Turkey, Salami & Provolone Panini (No Marinara Dip)
brandOrRestaurant: Pym Test Kitchen (Avengers Campus · Disney California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Pressed warm on soft focaccia bread with sliced turkey, ham, salami, and naturally low-lactose aged provolone cheese; skipping the marinara dipping cup and arugula salad makes it a solid Avengers Campus lunch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Individual Pym-ini Sandwich, remove any raw onions/lettuce, skip the red marinara dipping cup, and eat the potato tots on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the acidic marinara dipping sauce; remove cured salami slices if sensitive to peppercorns/nitrates
